# guftagu.ai — گفتگو

**Urdu-first AI customer support, grounded only in your own documents.**

guftagu.ai is a B2B support widget. A business uploads its FAQs / policy
documents, embeds a one-line chat widget on its site, and its customers chat in
**Urdu (اردو)** or **Roman Urdu**. Answers are generated by Claude **strictly
from the business's own documents** via RAG — if the docs don't cover a
question, the AI says so instead of guessing, and the business gets an
escalation email with the transcript.

> "guftagu" (گفتگو) means *conversation* in Urdu.

---

## How it works (the RAG pipeline)

```
customer message (Urdu / Roman Urdu)
        │
        ▼
embed the query ─────────────► Pinecone (namespaced per business)
        │                          │ top-k relevant chunks
        ▼                          ▼
        Claude ── context chunks + query ──► grounded answer in the
                                             customer's own script
        │
        ├── low confidence? ──► flag conversation + Resend email to business
        └── chat log stored in Supabase
```

Key safety property: the model is instructed to answer **only** from the
retrieved context and to say "I don't know" otherwise, so one business's data
can't leak into another's answers and nothing is hallucinated.

---

## Stack

| Concern       | Choice                                   |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| Framework     | Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript        |
| Styling       | Tailwind CSS                             |
| Vector store  | Pinecone (one namespace per business)    |
| DB / Auth     | Supabase (Postgres + Auth + RLS)         |
| LLM           | Anthropic Claude (grounded answers)      |
| Embeddings    | Hugging Face `multilingual-e5-large` (default) or OpenAI |
| Email         | Resend (escalation + transcripts)        |

### Why these embedding models?
Claude doesn't produce embeddings, so a separate model is needed. The default
is **`intfloat/multilingual-e5-large`** (via Hugging Face Inference API) because
it's multilingual-first and handles both Urdu script and Roman Urdu well, and it
has a free tier. **OpenAI `text-embedding-3-small`** is offered as a cheap,
highly reliable fallback. Switch via `EMBEDDING_PROVIDER`.

## Getting started

### 1. Install

```bash
npm install
```

### 2. Configure environment

```bash
cp .env.example .env
```

Fill in the values. You'll need projects/keys from Supabase, Pinecone,
Anthropic, Resend, and (for the default embedder) Hugging Face.

### 3. Create the database schema

Open the Supabase **SQL editor** and run the contents of
[`supabase/schema.sql`](supabase/schema.sql). This creates the `businesses`,
`documents`, `chats`, and `messages` tables, indexes, an `updated_at` trigger,
and row-level-security policies.

> **Tip:** In Supabase → Authentication → Providers → Email, disable
> "Confirm email" for a smooth local/dev signup flow.

### 4. Create the Pinecone index

The index is created automatically on first document upload (serverless,
cosine, in the region/cloud from your env). You can also create it ahead of
time in the Pinecone console named whatever `PINECONE_INDEX` is set to.

### 5. Run

```bash
npm run dev
```

Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000).

---

## Core user flows

1. **Sign up / log in** (Supabase Auth) → business dashboard.
2. **Upload FAQs/policy docs** (PDF or text) → chunked → embedded → stored in
   Pinecone under the business's own namespace.
3. **Copy the embed snippet** (a single `<script>` tag) onto your website.
4. A **customer opens the widget** and chats in Urdu or Roman Urdu.
5. Each message → embed query → retrieve top-k chunks from that business's
   namespace → Claude answers **only** from those chunks, in the same
   language/script the customer used.
6. If retrieval confidence is low or Claude can't answer from context, the
   conversation is **flagged** and a **Resend email** with the transcript is
   sent to the business.
7. All chat logs are stored in Supabase and viewable in the dashboard, with
   flagged/escalated conversations highlighted.

---

## Project structure

```
app/
  (auth)/            # login, signup, and auth server actions
  dashboard/         # business dashboard (documents + chat logs)
  widget/            # hosted widget UI (embedded via <script>/<iframe>)
  api/
    widget/          # public chat endpoint (RAG query)
    documents/       # document upload + processing
lib/
  supabase/          # browser/server/admin clients + proxy session guard
  rag/               # chunking, embedding, retrieval, grounded generation
  email/             # Resend escalation emails
proxy.ts             # Next.js proxy (session refresh + route protection)
supabase/schema.sql  # Postgres schema + RLS
public/widget.js     # lightweight embeddable loader script
```

## Environment variables

See [`.env.example`](.env.example) for the full annotated list. Highlights:

- `SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`
  (plus `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` / `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` mirrors —
  Next.js only exposes `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` to the browser bundle)
- `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_MODEL`
- `PINECONE_API_KEY`, `PINECONE_INDEX`, `PINECONE_CLOUD`, `PINECONE_REGION`
- `EMBEDDING_PROVIDER` (`hf` or `openai`), `HF_API_TOKEN`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`
- `RESEND_API_KEY`, `EMAIL_FROM`
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL`

`.env` is git-ignored; only `.env.example` is committed.

---

## Security model

- **Per-business isolation** — vectors live in a Pinecone namespace keyed by
  business id; every query is scoped to that namespace.
- **Row-level security** — Supabase RLS lets a business read only its own
  documents, chats, and messages.
- **Service role is server-only** — the admin client that bypasses RLS is
  confined to server code and never shipped to the browser.

---

## Deploying

Works on [Vercel](https://vercel.com). Set the same environment variables in
the Vercel project settings, run the SQL schema once against your Supabase
project, and deploy.
